trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.right: I have been studying English since 2020.
trap.why: Em português “estudo desde 2020” (presente). Com since/for e ação em curso, o inglês exige present perfect continuous.

mcq.q: Resultado visível: “Your eyes are red. You **___**.”

fix.wrong: I am living here since June.
fix.right: I have been living here since June.

fix.wrong: She has been work for hours.
fix.right: She has been working for hours.

fix.wrong: They have been wait since noon.
fix.right: They have been waiting since noon.
